Qlik Sense: Technology Overview Before to Hire Qlik Sense Programmer

Qlik Sense is part of the analytics tools suite of Qlik, a company founded in Sweden but is now based in the United States. In a nutshell, Qlik Sense is a data analytics and visualization tool that allows individuals and groups to explore, visualize and interact with data in various forms. This is especially useful for businesses as it gives them important insights into their various processes and helps them make data-driven decisions.

The Qlik Sense software has three versions:

  • Qlik Sense Cloud Basic, a free, cloud-based version of their service that gives access to up to 5 users
  • Qlik Sense Cloud Business, the paid version of their cloud-based service that offers collaborative functionalities in addition to data visualization and exploration
  • Qlik Sense Enterprise, a fully-featured version of their service that offers collaboration features, scalability, additional features via APIs, and the ability to be deployed to both local machines and the cloud

Currently, Qlik has over 40,000 customers from over 100 countries. As a data analysis platform for technical users, Qlik Sense is a program for data analysis and visualization. This software helps to analyze data obtained from different sources, conducting a dynamic search. Qlik Sense clearly stands out against the background of a similar QlikView software as its specialization is more focused on visualizing the data received. So QlikView developers will perform different tasks rather than Qlik Sense developer. If your goal is to graphically display data analysis, then Qlik Sense will be the right choice for your company.

Thus, Qlik Sense is a flexible tool to use, as the user can perform independent operations related to the analysis and visual representation of data. At the same time, Qlik Sense uses search and analysis not on the basis of queries, but on the basis of an associative search and comparison model, which allowed the system to have access to a much wider field of data from different sources and intuitive information. Using such properties, users can get smart conclusions from data, export reports, and data models, which helps in business optimization.

First of all, working with Qlik Sense assumes that the platform works on mobile devices.  Although Qlik Sense allows you to quickly adapt to any device and connect through the cloud network, the transition from QlikView to Qlik Sense is quite a difficult task. The Qlik Sense developer must design the final product so that it initially works and can be easily used on all devices. There are 3 aspects of transferring the Qlik Sense to a mobile device that requires special attention. These aspects are user experience, context, and integration with other platforms and technologies. Mobile devices are more application-oriented than browsers, and this should be facilitated.

The Competition: Qlik Sense Development vs Tableau

Perhaps two of the biggest technology providers available are Qlik and Tableau. Both have very similar features and functionalities. Let’s do a quick side-by-side comparison of the two to highlight their differences.

Tableau with Qlik Sense are systems that can be regarded as the most effective for self-service. Although both systems are executors for data analysis, there are some differences. Though the differences are slight, we see that although tableau may be more popular based on the number of reviews, Qlik Sense development also has a lot to offer and is worth taking a closer look at.

Qlik Sense initially was in demand for companies with an indexing mechanism while Tableau was used for data visualizations and ad hoc queries. In the process of optimizing these two tools, they got the same features and purpose of service. At a time when Qlik Sense for developers has primarily broad corporate capabilities, including scalability (the QIX data engine), reusable reporting and wide access to data, it is the best tool in visualization. In turn, Tableau represents the Hyperdata processing mechanism, which should simplify data detection and analysis. In the long run, Hyper is expected to integrate IoT analytics. Tableau also has the function of connecting to real-time data sources (SAP HANA, Teradata).

Business Benefits to Hire Qlik Sense Engineer

Qlik Sense for developers is an effective tool for quickly sharing your organization with data and key ideas, as the program allows you to perform data preparation in an intuitively simple way. In this way, Qlik Sense simplifies data exploration by making it available for a wider range of users. Using Open Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), developers can easily embed Qlik Sense into many applications, adding to them the function of expanding and incorporating more features, adjusting to the unique needs of organizations.

The Qlik Sense platform was developed based on HTML5 and JavaScript, popular modern web languages, and also integrated access to open APIs. Using Qlik Sense Mashup functionality, companies have the opportunity to develop and add Qlik Sense analytic functions to existing systems or websites. This feature simplifies the collection and processing of company information and the business environment as a whole by integrating with any external data sources. One of the remarkable advantages of Qlik Sense is its mobile-friendly, responsive design. Being completely responsive, the Qlik Sense interface saves interface development time for different end-user devices, as it has the ability to automatically adapt to any device.

Qlik Sense Developer Tech Skills & Responsibilities

Qlik Sense is one of the leading technologies in the software business world, so the Qlik Sense Developer profession is in demand in many areas. At the same time, the name of the job title may differ depending on the main positions and types of work, the market may require Qlik sense engineer, data architect, data specialist, technical consultant, etc. Each Qlik Sense coder is characterized by a separate list of duties to be performed by a specialist. When planning to hire a Qlik Sense developer, the skill set to look for is vast. Here are some of the most important skills they should have.

  • Mastery of the software. A Qlik Sense consultant must be highly proficient in the software and tools that he will use. In this case, he should have a mastery of all Qlik Sense features, including advanced functionalities such as using Qlik Sense’s web API.
  • Data science. Data science is a formal discipline that involves processing and extracting large volumes of data – so-called big data — and turn them into useful forms that can easily be analyzed. This entails skills such as data extraction, pre-processing, visualization, and presentation. A Qlik Sense expert must, therefore, be well-versed in these areas.
  • Database querying. Any Qlik Sense development tool makes use of data stored in databases, so a Qlik Sense developer has to be proficient in creating and executing SQL queries. This includes creating, reading, updating, and deleting entries into and from different types of database systems like MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle Database, and MongoDB. A good developer must therefore also be a good SQL developer or Oracle developer.
  • Grasp of statistics. Business intelligence developers will be constantly dealing with numbers and graphs, so having a strong grasp of statistical concepts is a must. This will be critical in analyzing data to make sense of the different numbers and to effectively process and transform data into useful knowledge.
